frozen_constants.comment: S*/LEAK/KP/KI inherited byte-identical from H_1292 hunger (sibling). KC=1.0 cue-incentive gain. DA_GAIN=1.0 dopaminergic-analog wanting amplifier (the Berridge lever: raises WANTING not LIKING).

mechanism: Libido L_t = incentive-salience accumulator. wanting = Kp*deficit + Ki*I + Kc*cue_match*(1+da_gain). deficit/I = the SAME setpoint leaky-integral as hunger (deprivation time-integral). cue_match = affinity of a CONDITIONED cue to its paired-incentive cell off the LIVE immune store (the cue-driven incentive component hunger lacks). da_gain = dopaminergic-analog gain amplifying WANTING. liking (hedonic/consummation value) = a FIXED hedonic readout at consummation, read off the store margin, NOT amplified by da_gain. consummatory grounded event RESETS the integral (like hunger). ALL components read substrate state (deprivation time, cue-match off the store, consummation margin) — NO injected 'arousal/horny' label (p6/p2/p3). Ψ-disjoint READ-only.

frozen_bars.A_BUILDUP: drive rises with deprivation AND spikes on conditioned cue: rise_full (deprivation-only build) >= 0.50 AND cue_spike (cue-present wanting - no-cue wanting) >= 0.50. BOTH components present.
frozen_bars.B_DOUBLE_DISSOCIATION: vs hunger H_1292. sexual-cue presentation -> libido wanting UP (cue_spike >= 0.50) while hunger ~flat (hunger_cue_delta < 0.05); food-deprivation -> hunger UP (hunger_rise >= 0.50) while libido cue-component ~flat under no-cue (libido_food_only_cue_delta < 0.05). Cross-signature dissociates the two drives.
frozen_bars.C_WANTING_NOT_LIKING: the HEADLINE (Berridge). a dopaminergic-analog gain (da_gain 0->1) raises WANTING (wanting_da1 - wanting_da0 >= 0.50) while LIKING stays flat (|liking_da1 - liking_da0| <= 0.02). Incentive salience dissociates from hedonic value.
frozen_bars.D_EARNED_ABLATE: remove cue-conditioning (Kc:=0) -> drive loses its cue-spike: ablated cue_spike <= 0.05 (deficit-only residual, like plain hunger).
frozen_bars.E_EARNED_SHUFFLE: permute cue<->incentive-cell pairing -> cue-specificity decorrelates to chance: shuffled cue_match <= 0.50 * paired cue_match (correlation cue-specificity collapses).

verdict_rule: GREEN iff A AND B AND C AND D AND E. If C fails (wanting and liking move TOGETHER) -> HONEST finding that the substrate does NOT separate incentive from hedonic value (report as the real result, candidate engine extension). NO tune-to-green; bars frozen BEFORE scoring; c9.
